description_en: Query the list and basic information of all team shared drives in the enterprise cloud drive
description_zh: 查询企业网盘内所有团队共享盘的列表及基本信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-cloud-drive-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cds-id cn-shanghai+cds-1355150000 --group-id cg-i1ruuudp92qpj0000 --group-name Test_team_1 --parent-group-id cg-e70ga4ixp30ur0000 --drive-status enabled --group-type org --drive-type binding --directory-id cn-hangzhou+dir-jedbpr4sl9l370000 --directory-name testDirectoryName --max-results 10 --next-token AAAAAV3MpHK1AP0pfERHZN5pu6lY3I2VNHLwy+nIoSXh0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCloudDriveGroups

parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud disk in Cloud Drive Service
parameters.name: cds_id

parameters.help_en: The team name for fuzzy search
parameters.help_zh: 团队空间名称，支持模糊查询
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the parent node. If a parent node ID is specified, the subnodes are queried. If you set the value of this parameter to root, the root node is queried.

Default value: null. The default value indicates that all nodes are queried
parameters.help_zh:
待查询对象的父节点ID。查询根节点时，填`root`。

默认为空，表示查询全部
parameters.name: parent_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The team space status. Valid values:

- enabled

- disabled

Default value: enabled
parameters.name: drive_status

parameters.help_en:
The team type.

- org: organizational structure

- directory: workspace

Default value: null. The default value indicates that all types of teams are queried
parameters.help_zh: 团队类型。默认为空，表示查询全部
parameters.name: group_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the space is increased.

- binding: increased

- unbound: not increased

Default value: null. The default value indicates that all spaces are queried
parameters.help_zh: 是否添加空间。默认为空，表示查询全部
parameters.name: drive_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

- Valid values: 1 to 100

- Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

- 最大值：100
- 默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token
